children: VerityAI, an AI-based trusted reputation network, received an investment from AURUMX Capital on October 16. According to ChainCatcher, AURUMX Capital holds Hong Kong SFC Type 4 and Type 9 licenses and MSB credentials, and VerityAI had previously received investments from Titan Foundation USA and BlockX.

VerityAI aims to turn market research and predictive signals into verifiable on-chain reputation assets and build a system for assessing contributors’ credibility in digital markets. AURUMX Capital plans to draw on its institutional resources to support the use of VerityAI’s verifiable reputation infrastructure in institutional settings.
VerityAI’s Signal Explorer supports Morph Mainnet and BNB Chain. As of October 16, 2026, it had generated nearly 20,000 on-chain signals.

title: VerityAI Secures Investment From AURUMX Capital to Expand Multi-Chain Reputation Infrastructure
